title: UNDERRIDE CRITICALITY
description: Technical analysis of truck underride collisions. We investigate Mansfield bar failures and structural defects in rear-impact guards.
heading: UNDERRIDE
intro: Most underride fatalities are preventable. We hold carriers and manufacturers accountable for substandard rear and side impact guards.

analysisPoints.title: Underride Guard Integrity
analysisPoints.detail: We evaluate the "Mansfield Bar" for welding defects, rust, or structural non-compliance with FMVSS No. 223/224 standards.

analysisPoints.title: Crash Compatibility
analysisPoints.detail: Analysis of relative heights and energy absorption. We prove when a guard was positioned too high to stop a passenger vehicle from sliding underneath.

analysisPoints.title: Secondary Impact Velocity
analysisPoints.detail: The true danger of underride is the secondary impact with the passenger compartment (PCI). We measure the deformation of the A-pillars and roof.

analysisPoints.title: Material Science Audit
analysisPoints.detail: Testing the steel alloy of the rear-impact guard to ensure it met the minimum yield strength required to sustain a high-velocity impact.

detail: When a rear-impact guard fails, the passenger vehicle experiences "compartment intrusion." We utilize 3D laser scanning of the wreckage to prove that the guard folded due to fatigue or improper mounting.
